fusions.name: Beak Grind
fusions.desc: Grinds at the target with a hard beak for 4 damage, leaving it 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Polyp Bloom
fusions.desc: Stings the area around you, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Reef Shelter
fusions.desc: Raises a reef where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and every ally within 4 tiles of it. Its effect grows 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Slow Accretion
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once into a shield worth 8% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second.
